author: ThioJoe
description:
Wasn't expecting a sequel 😩

Yet another Linux zero-day exploit happened called Dirty Frag, and the circumstances around it are pretty interesting, and could signal more to come. Basically someone saw a commit patch for an exploit that hadn't been disclosed yet, and reverse-engineered it and made their own post about it. But this was all before the patch made it into downstream distros, leaving everyone scrambling to patch sooner than they otherwise would have needed to.
